Permutation invariance plus uniqueness of optimum permits equal dual weights within each sign orbit. For y=2alpha−1, logdet is (n−1)log(1+t²+2ty)+log(1−y²), strictly concave; the first-order polynomial P(y)=(n+1)t y²+(1+t²)y−(n−1)t=0 is unique. With published center map K(x)=x−Qc/(1−tau), substitution gives scalar update t_+=t−(1−t²)(t+y)/(n(1−y²)−(t+y)²); multiplying denominator yields numerator −P(y). Thus t_+=0 for every n>=2 and |t|<1. At center cross-polytope has unique MinCE B_2^n and its polar recovers cube John ball. Invertible affine covariance returns b+AB_2^n. Exact oracle only; independent symbolic numerator cancellation and proof of strict concavity used, finite tests corroborative.
